easypoll_blocks:
/poll question: Class Symbol by ⛧ Inox ⛧ — send to Senate vote?
text:
Author: ⛧ Inox ⛧
Post: https://discord.com/channels/766364534495117383/1286801164326797385/1538621016454987847
Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/11p1PPma8uBoZFx_gZpqnrmF8FYCGvdABxP9mZ5Zui7w/edit?usp=drivesdk
Summary:
- Adds a Chapter 6 rule (before the NPC section): some spells and skills require touching a Class Symbol with a free hand during use.
- The symbol is the player's choice, fitting their persona: holy symbol, skeleton key, arcane medallion, crystal pendant, rune-carved bone, etc.
- Must be a real physical token (drawn/embroidered does not count) and needs Spell Marshal approval before use.
- Removes 'Symbol' from the class charts.
- Rationale: class symbols are not defined anywhere in the rules today.
answer-1: Yes
answer-2: No
answer-3: Abstain
name: Class Symbol
notes: Never appeared on a reviewed Senate agenda.
